verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document live-call monitoring dashboards, production alerting, or error-rate spike detection. Evals and Voice Test Suites are pre-production testing. Assistant hooks and Server URL `tool-calls` events are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to construct alerting, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
